tweet.text:
Check out http://github.com/unclebob/swarm-forge.  I forked this from my son Justin and modified it a lot. 

This is a neat little agent control system based on tmux.  It is really cool to see the agents talk to each other, give each other tasks, and manage their individual git worktrees and merge each others changes.  

I sometimes just sit back in awe as the agents do massive amounts of work, write hundreds of tests, build gherkins, refactor based on crap and mutate tests.  All under my watchful eye.
